items.text: In desperate moments of need, we can turn to the King of heaven and earth. When surrounded by adversity and evil, our path to deliverance is the same one Jehoshaphat sought. We can plead, 'Our eyes are upon thee.'

The Lord promised His protection to Jehoshaphat and his people when they faced overwhelming odds: 'Fear not, nor be dismayed.' This divine assurance is a comfort to us as well when we feel surrounded by challenges.

When facing trials, we must consider where we place our trust. Asa's life demonstrates the consequences of turning away from the Lord. Trusting in Him brings peace, while seeking help from others when the Lord is available can lead to sorrow.

We can defend the truth, even when it is unpopular. Micaiah faced immense pressure to conform, but he courageously spoke the Lord's word. We find courage to stand up for the Lord and His teachings when we are rooted in faith.

In difficult times, we can turn to God and His prophets. When multiple nations attacked Judah, King Jehoshaphat sought the Lord. We can apply his actions by turning to God in our own challenging circumstances.

The Lord's response to Jehoshaphat's prayer offers comfort: 'The battle is not yours, but God’s.' This teaches us that with faith and by following His prophets, God will bless us and fight our battles.
When we put exclamation points behind the prophet’s statements and act upon them, blessings pour down. Our interest should be in how we can be more like him, following his inspired counsel.

The scriptures are filled with doctrinal diamonds. When the light of the Spirit plays upon their facets, they sparkle and illuminate our path. We can find these powerful messages and ponder their meaning in our lives.
When facing overwhelming odds, remember that the battle is not yours, but God’s. Trust in Him and follow His prophets, and He will provide deliverance and strength beyond your own capabilities.
Asa’s life teaches us the importance of unwavering trust in the Lord. When we put our trust in God, we can find peace even amidst life’s greatest challenges and overcome them through His power.
